title: Approval contract

title: Notification contract

title: Outbound integration

normative_statement: Inspection results MUST target WCAG 2.2 AA with semantic labels, keyboard/focus, announced validation/status/hold state, non-color-only pass/fail, target sizing and accessible manual alternatives to scanning/touch-only actions.

normative_statement: Every Inspection results query/command MUST enforce server-side organization, company, site/warehouse/plant, quality team and record scope; sensitive supplier/customer findings, deviations and aggregates MUST not leak.

normative_statement: Sensitive Inspection results decisions such as use-as-is, hold release, disposition override, audit closure or CAPA effectiveness MUST support maker-checker/independence and prohibit self-approval where configured.

title: Approval contract

title: Notification contract
normative_statement: Inspection results notifications MUST be event-driven, deduplicated, permission-safe and actionable for failed/overdue inspection, new/aging hold/NCR/CAPA, calibration expiry, supplier/customer escalation, audit finding or reconciliation failure as applicable.

title: Reporting contract
normative_statement: Inspection results reporting MUST define formula/population, company/site/supplier/item/lot/severity/time scope, reopen/correction treatment, freshness, permission-safe drilldown/export and reconciliation to immutable source quality facts.

title: AI boundary

title: Inbound integration

title: Outbound integration

title: Command contract

title: Query contract

title: Operational envelope

title: Primary flow

title: Exception and reversal flow
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST define cancellation, correction, reopen/reversal or compensation semantics where business effects have already occurred.

title: Business invariants
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST enforce Support lifecycle, visibility, service-contract and cross-record invariants server-side.

title: Data contract
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST define stable IDs, tenant/company scope, timestamps, actor/channel/source references, relationships, indexes, retention and lineage.

title: Validation
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST reject invalid references, illegal transitions, malformed content, stale versions and out-of-scope records with actionable errors.

title: Deterministic calculations
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST define any SLA, duration, score, workload, rate or KPI formulas with timezone/calendar, precision and reproducibility rules.

title: Workspace UX
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST expose a keyboard-efficient desktop workspace and responsive tablet/phone representation with visible status and primary actions.

title: Authorization and visibility
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST enforce tenant/company/team/queue/record scope, action permissions, IDOR protection and sensitive/private field visibility on the server.

title: Automation
normative_statement: Complete audit trail automation MUST be policy-driven, idempotent, observable and never bypass authorization, private-note visibility or contractual service truth.

title: Approvals and SoD
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST use maker-checker/manager override approval where the action can expose private data, alter entitlement, merge history or materially affect service commitments.

title: Notifications
normative_statement: Complete audit trail notifications MUST be deduplicated, permission-safe, retryable, suppress loops and preserve delivery/bounce/retry evidence.

title: Reporting
normative_statement: Complete audit trail reporting MUST define permission-safe metrics, dimensions, filters, drilldown, freshness and reconciliation to operational source records.

title: AI boundary
normative_statement: AI MAY assist with Complete audit trail classification, summary, drafting, retrieval or risk signals but MUST NOT authorize access, expose private notes, determine entitlement/SLA truth, destructively merge records or make illegal state transitions.

title: Integration contract
normative_statement: Complete audit trail cross-module effects MUST use public idempotent contracts with source IDs, authorization, retries, reversal/reconciliation and audit; no private-table mutation.

title: API/command contract
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST define commands/queries, schemas, errors, pagination/filtering, optimistic concurrency/idempotency and audit/outbox effects.

title: Performance envelope
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST define latency, search/indexing, pagination/virtualization and asynchronous thresholds for enterprise ticket volumes and peak service periods.

title: Observability
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST emit structured business/technical telemetry with correlation IDs, queue/job retries, SLA-risk diagnostics and reconciliation views.

title: Critical E2E
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST have browser/device E2E covering success, permission denial, concurrency conflict, retry/failure and cross-module outcomes.

title: Human acceptance

title: Audit-visible reason
normative_statement: Material changes to Complete audit trail MUST capture actor, timestamp and reason where operationally significant.

title: Concurrent actor flow
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST resolve simultaneous agent/customer/automation actions without silent last-write-wins data loss.

title: History/version lineage
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST preserve source message/event/version lineage so service history remains reconstructable after merge, reopen, reassignment or correction.

title: Scope validation
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST validate customer/contact/ticket/queue/asset/order references belong to the same authorized tenant/company context.

title: Private/public separation
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST preserve the distinction between customer-visible communication and internal/private operational content in every read/export/search/notification path.

title: Exception recovery UX
normative_statement: Complete audit trail MUST explain failed, stale, duplicate, offline or externally uncertain actions and present a safe next step rather than encouraging blind retry.

title: Sensitive-content minimization

title: Retry/reconciliation contract

title: Search/queue scale

title: Support diagnostics

title: Security-negative E2E

title: Recovery/reconciliation UAT

title: AI provenance and override
